title: Assess an improvement during the next comparable activity
actor: An improvement owner observing subsequent engineering work
goal: Determine the observed effect of an adopted improvement against its intended behavior and possible adverse effects, or identify that effectiveness remains unassessed when no comparable activity has occurred.
context: An improvement has been adopted with assessment criteria; adoption alone has not established effectiveness.
trigger: The triggering situation can be reproduced or a subsequent comparable activity occurs.
preconditions: The adopted improvement, applicability context, and success/adverse-effect criteria are identifiable.

interaction.action: Supplies observations of the triggering situation when reproducible and identifies whether comparable later work has occurred.
Distinguishes the triggering result from the later opportunity and identifies missing or noncomparable observations.
Provides recurrence, intended behavior, confusion, or burden observed during the next comparable activity.
Reports the context-bounded assessment with contradictory evidence, incomplete scope, and unassessed effectiveness explicit.

expected_outcome: The assessment states what was observed during a comparable opportunity and what remains unassessed without interpreting elapsed time as proof.

alternatives.condition: The triggering situation cannot be reproduced.
alternatives.outcome: That limit is recorded while the next comparable activity remains the opportunity for observing practical effects.

alternatives.condition: No comparable activity has yet occurred.
alternatives.outcome: Effectiveness remains unassessed even when adoption or a triggering reproduction succeeded.

alternatives.condition: The mechanism recurs or a new adverse effect appears.
alternatives.outcome: The report retains the unsuccessful or mixed result and calls for review instead of presenting success.

failures.condition: Observations lack an applicable context or cannot support the criteria.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the insufficient basis rather than claiming improvement.

sources.basis: Analyzes IR-007 through a distinct stakeholder goal within the selected initial authoring profile; the owning IR records Scenario ownership. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage.
